creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From #153, batch 13, item 7.

There is no `rad test` and no in-file test block. A 3,200-line CLI could only test its Markdown converter end to end, through a `convert` subcommand and a golden-file runner. The REPL's `:load` can load an args-free library file driven over a pipe, but it refuses any file with an args block, commands or a header (sprint `a_2AHgluUMf`).

Design call, closely tied to imports (`a_25Ni06X2R`): a test runner needs to call a script's functions without running its top-level code, which is the same constraint the imports RED records.
title: Add a way to test Rad functions without going through the CLI
